reference.title: KWIC Sort
reference.shortdesc: You can rearrange your search results using KWIC sort option in Concordance tool.

section.p: You can rearrange your search results in KWIC pane using KWIC sort option. Search results can be rearranged on three different levels:

strow.stentry: Number of words to the left of the search word
Number of words to the right of the search word

section.p: By adjusting values in Level fields, you can see your search results in context of the other words in the line. Ensure to check the desired Level fields and click Sort to see the search results displayed in context.

p.note: KWIC sort option can only be applied to single keyword. It does not work with search queries with mutliple keywords.
